name: i2c_sensor_tmp102
summary: TI TMP102 I2C temperature sensor at address 0x48 (ADD0 to GND), with its 0.01 uF supply bypass and SCL/SDA pull-ups sized from the bus capacitance.

sources.document: TI TMP102 datasheet SBOS397I, 5.3 Recommended Operating Conditions (V+ 1.4-3.6 V)
TI TMP102 datasheet SBOS397I, 5.5 Electrical Characteristics: average quiescent current 10 uA typical with the serial bus active at 400 kHz
TI TMP102 datasheet SBOS397I, table 4-1 Pin Functions (SDA and ALERT are open-drain and need pull-ups; ADD0 to GND or V+)
TI TMP102 datasheet SBOS397I, table 6-4 Address Pin and Target Addresses (ADD0 = ground: 1001000)
TI TMP102 datasheet SBOS397I, power supply recommendations: a 0.01 uF supply bypass capacitor, as close as possible to the supply and ground pins
TI application note SLVA689A, I2C Bus Pullup Resistor Calculation: Rp(min) = (VCC - VOL(max)) / IOL, Rp(max) = tr / (0.8473 x Cb); table 2-1 (fast mode tr 300 ns; VOL 0.4 V at 3 mA for VCC > 2 V)

ports.name: v3v3
ports.note: 10 uA is the typical supply current with the bus active at 400 kHz (no maximum is given); the pull-up current is not included

notes.text: Address 0x48: ADD0 is tied to GND.
ALERT is open-drain and unused here, so it is left unconnected; it would need a pull-up if used.

The bus capacitance is not assumed: it must be given (it depends on the trace length and every device on the bus). Fast mode (tr 300 ns) is the default; bus_voltage must be above 2 V for the VOL 0.4 V at 3 mA figure.
One pair of pull-ups per bus: when several I2C blocks share a bus, the composer must keep one pair (Phase 2c).
